<translate>
<!--T:7-->
'''Frost Demons''' are a race of intergalactic conquerors with immense power and boundless cruelty. Their ability to transform and increase their power makes them formidable enemies, and despite their fragile appearance they are some of the deadliest creatures in the universe. In DragonMineZ they earn more Training Points and form mastery than any other race, shrug off part of the damage of techniques, and store Ki in a '''Power Reserve''' that feeds their forms.
</translate>

<translate>
== Overview and strengths == <!--T:8-->

<!--T:9-->
* '''Faster growth.''' Prodigious Strength gives you 25% more TP from every source, and Evolutionary Mastery makes your forms gain 25% more mastery.
* '''Tough body.''' Hardened Body reduces the damage you take from Ki and strike techniques.
* '''Power Reserve.''' Fighting at low Power Release fills a Ki reserve that later lets a form run with no Ki upkeep and stronger bonuses.
* '''Evolution floor.''' Once you reach your Final Form, running out of Ki or pressing Descend only drops you back to Final Form, not to base.
</translate>

<translate>

</translate>

| <translate><!--T:19--> '''Power Reserve'''</translate> || <translate><!--T:20--> In base form or in your Second, Third or Final Form, with Power Release at '''25%''' or less, you store Ki in a reserve of up to '''50%''' of your max Ki (full in '''30 seconds'''). <translate>

All four parts work on their own. The Power Reserve has its own meter on the [[Special:MyLanguage/HUD|HUD]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Transformations == <!--T:22-->
</translate>
{{Main|Transformations}}
<translate>
<!--T:41-->
''Level'' is the level of the form skill (Super Forms or Legendary Forms) that unlocks the form, and ''TP cost'' is the price of that level. Each form after the first of its group also needs '''25% mastery''' on the previous one. Multipliers are the defaults at 0% mastery and grow up to 1.5 times at 100% mastery. ''Ki drain'' is the base upkeep per tick; see [[Special:MyLanguage/Transformations#Energy consumption while transformed|energy consumption]].
</translate>

<translate>
=== Evolution floor === <!--T:43-->

<!--T:44-->
Once a Frost Demon reaches its '''Final Form''' or a higher form, the Descend key and running out of energy only drop it back to '''Final Form''', not to base. To go lower, use '''Descend''' from the radial ('''X''') menu.
</translate>

<translate>
== Appearance == <!--T:45-->
</translate>
{{Main|Character Customization}}
<translate>
<!--T:46-->
* '''Hair:''' no. Frost Demons wear '''horns''' instead (head parts <code>horns1</code> to <code>horns5</code>), picked on the Hair tab.
* '''Gender:''' no.
* '''Body types:''' 3 base body types, with body type 0 as the default. The race also has dedicated bodies for its later forms (such as the Final and Fifth Forms).
* '''Size:''' the default model is smaller than other races (scale 0.7375).
* '''Face:''' besides their own nose and mouth options, Frost Demons can pick the human ones, listed after their own.
</translate>

<translate>
== Notes == <!--T:47-->

<!--T:48-->
* A [[Special:MyLanguage/Glind|Glind]] of the opposite alignment deals '''15%''' more damage to Frost Demons, instead of the usual 10% (see Light and Darkness).
</translate>

<translate>
== Configuration == <!--T:49-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:50-->
The four parts of the racial skill are tuned in the <code>frostdemon</code> section of <code>racialSkills</code> in <code>general-server.json</code>, including the TP multiplier (the <code>RACIALSKILL</code> TP boost) and the forms in which the reserve charges. The Super Forms TP ladder is in <code>races/frostdemon/character.json</code>, and each form's values are in its form file.
</translate>
{{See also|General Server Config|Custom Races|Custom Forms}}
